scene: You tumble through the swirling portal into Pixel City's grand transit terminal.
picture: Flat side view. Along a metallic platform, the grandmother in pink tracksuit stands on the left, holding her white dog's lead. On the far left sits a red double-decker hover bus. In the centre floats a tethered drone gondola with striped awnings. On the far right waits a brass spiral tram on corkscrew tracks.
shown: a bright red double-decker hover bus idling at the far left bay
a striped gondola hanging beneath a buzzing drone tethered in the centre
a sleek spiral tram resting on coiled rails on the far right
